description: PLANNED (plan T14 R1; OpenVibe.Run is not built yet): Submit a job to OpenVibe.Run: POST /api/v1/jobs. The job belongs to the token's project, which is billed per wall-clock second it runs (service run, operation function.invoke, unit s). An idempotency_key makes a retry return the first job. It becomes active, and enters generated/openapi/run.json, when OpenVibe.Run implements the routes.
